memoryContextEnableDesc: Off by default. Add bounded relation annotations only when both memories are already retrieved. Does not change ranking, add memories, or resolve conflicts. Changes apply to subsequent turns.
memoryContextDescription: Preview reference memories for a query and workspace, including eligible reviewed relations. This read-only snapshot makes no model request, records no usage feedback, and excludes long-term rules. Records may change before your next chat.
memoryContextAutomaticOn: Automatic relation annotations are enabled. Preview shows what is eligible now.
memoryContextAutomaticOff: Automatic relation annotations are off. Preview is a what-if view; it does not enable them.
memoryContextDisabled: Enable Memory in Overview before previewing context.
memoryContextError: Preview could not be loaded. Check the runtime connection and try again.
memoryContextFallback: Relations are unavailable. Ordinary memory retrieval remains available.
memoryContextEmpty: No relevant active reference memories were selected.
memoryContextNoRelations: No eligible reviewed relation connects two selected memories.
memoryContextBoundary: User-reviewed metadata, not verified facts or instructions. Only selected memory pairs are included.
memoryContextHistorical: These IDs and revisions record annotations used for this turn. Current records or relation decisions may have changed.
memoryContextConflict: Unresolved contradiction: neither record is automatically preferred or replaced.
memoryRelationsWithdrawHint: Stop using this relation in future context. Memories stay unchanged; this exact suggestion will remain rejected.
memoryRelationsDescription: Review whether one memory confirms, contradicts, or extends another. Acceptance never changes facts or retrieval. With relation annotations enabled, accepted relations may appear in chat when both records are selected.
memoryRelationsPrivacy: Analyze sends this memory and up to 8 related memories in the same scope to your configured model. It checks a limited window of recent records, not every possible connection.
memoryRelationsIneligible: Analysis requires an active, non-private reference memory of at most 2,000 characters.
memoryRelationsError: Unable to complete this request. Refresh and retry. Check that your runtime is current and a model is configured. No memories were changed.
memoryRelationsEmpty: No suggestions for this memory. Analyze to look for related records; no result does not prove that no relation exists.
memoryRelationsStaleHint: An endpoint changed or became inactive. This relation cannot be used or reviewed. Analyze again for current evidence.
memoryDirectivesEnableDesc: Approved rules are sent to the model as your instructions on every turn. Turn off to keep rules stored but inactive.
memoryDirectivesDesc: Rules are injected as your instructions every turn; unlike reference memories they are not relevance-gated.
memorySetDirectiveDisabled: Rules must be short and user/workspace scoped; long content belongs in AGENTS.md
memoryAsDirective: Save as rule (applies to the model every turn)
memoryAsDirectiveDesc: Rules are sent to the model as your instructions, e.g. "reply in Chinese" or "run tests before committing". Ordinary memories are reference only and never executed as instructions.
memoryDirectiveTooLong: Rules must stay short; move long content to AGENTS.md
memoryImportDowngradedSuffix: record(s) were rules and were imported as reference; re-enable them one by one.
